'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks in Russia during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***At least seven [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] drones strike [[Kazan]], [[Russia]], six of which reportedly hit residential areas, including a 32-story [[Apartment|apartment building]]. [https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2024/12/21/7490106/ (''Ukrainska Pravda'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russias-kazan-airport-temporarily-halts-operations-aviation-watchdog-says-2024-12-21/ (Reuters)]
*[[Haitian crisis (2018–present)|Haitian crisis]]
**The [[Government of Haiti|Haitian government]] declares a one-month state of emergency amid the escalating gang violence and the deepening security crisis. [https://www.caribbeannationalweekly.com/news/haiti-declares-one-month-state-of-emergency-amid-escalating-gang-violence/ (''Caribbean National Weekly'')]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**Sixteen [[Pakistan Army]] soldiers are killed and five others are critically injured when [[Pakistani Taliban]] militants launch an overnight raid on an army post in [[Makeen]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2024/12/21/pakistan-militant-raid-kills-16-soldiers-intelligence-officials- (Al Arabiya)]
*[[Red Sea crisis]]
**Sixteen people are injured in a [[Houthi movement|Houthi]] missile attack on the [[Tel Aviv]]-[[Jaffa]] area in [[Israel]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2024/12/20/middleeast/tel-aviv-hit-by-projectile-from-yemen-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Constitutional crisis in Somalia]]
**The [[Puntland]] region of [[Somalia]] announces that it will introduce a new regional currency in 2025. The region had previously shifted to use of the [[United States dollar]] in 2021, due to severe [[inflation]] of the [[Somali shilling]]. [https://www.garoweonline.com/en/news/somalia/puntland-to-introduce-own-currency-deepening-rift-with-somalia-s-government (Garowe Online)] [https://www.hiiraan.com/news4/2024/Dec/199465/puntland_state_president_announces_plan_to_introduce_regional_currency_by_2025.aspx  (Hiiraan Online)] [https://horseedmedia.net/puntland-to-launch-own-currency-by-2025-amid-somalias-monetary-challenges/397646/ (Horseed Media)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Minas Gerais road crash]]
**Forty-one people are killed and seven more are injured when a bus collides with a [[granite]] block that fell from a truck on a highway in [[Minas Gerais]], [[Brazil]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/dec/21/at-least-22-people-killed-in-tragic-bus-crash-in-brazil (''The Guardian'')] [https://g1.globo.com/mg/vales-mg/noticia/2024/12/21/acidente-em-mg-e-a-maior-tragedia-em-rodovias-federais-pelo-menos-desde-2007-inicio-da-serie-historica-da-prf.ghtml (G1)] [https://oglobo.globo.com/google/amp/brasil/minas-gerais/noticia/2024/12/22/tragedia-em-minas-sobe-para-41-o-numero-de-mortos-em-acidente-em-teofilo-otoni.ghtml (''O Globo'')]
*Ten people are killed and many others are injured in a [[Human stampede|stampede]] during a distribution of food and clothes at a church in [[Abuja]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://apnews.com/article/nigeria-stampede-christmas-406a2e4839c579ed07462a7780de9c42 (AP)]
*Nine people are killed and 13 more injured when a bus plunges into a [[ravine]] in [[Pa Alam]], [[Lorestan province|Lorestan]], [[Iran]]. [https://apnews.com/article/iran-road-accident-nine-dead-1455692cf7a901073fa7e2e089e49e42 (AP)]
*Two people are killed and three others are missing when an under-construction six-story building collapses in [[Sohana|Sohana village]], [[Mohali district]], [[India]]. [https://zeenews.india.com/india/mohali-building-collapse-himachal-woman-dies-rescue-ops-underway-top-updates-2834513.html (Zee News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Censorship of TikTok]]
**The [[Albanian government]] announces a one-year ban on the [[social media]] platform [[TikTok]] beginning in 2025, following a fatal [[stabbing]] of a teenager in November in connection to a confrontation on the platform. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/12/21/albania-bans-tiktok-for-one-year-following-school-stabbing (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.turkiyetoday.com/region/albania-to-ban-tiktok-for-one-year-starting-in-2025-95830/ (Türkiye Today)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 Icelandic parliamentary election]]
**The [[Social Democratic Alliance]], led by [[Kristrún Frostadóttir]], forms a [[coalition government]] in [[Iceland]]'s [[Althing]] with the [[Viðreisn|Liberal Reform Party]] and the [[People's Party (Iceland)|People's Party]]. Frostadóttir becomes Iceland's youngest [[Prime Minister of Iceland|prime minister]] at 36 years old. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/world/iceland-social-democrats-present-new-coalition-government-4821056 (CNA)]
*[[2025 United States federal budget]], [[Government shutdowns in the United States]]
**The [[United States Senate]] passes a funding bill, with [[President of the United States|President]] [[Joe Biden]] subsequently signing the bill into law, thereby averting a government shutdown. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/government-shutdown-congress-trump-elon-musk/ (CBS News)]
